problem: People want to eat well daily but cooking takes hours.
business_model: Consumer hardware sale with preorder deposits

education: Studied computer science and economics (per YC page); dropped out
previous_startups: School-finding app that reached 100k+ users in six months (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: From southern France, moved to Paris.

education: Computer science school (dropped out, per YC page)

competitors.what: Countertop robot that cooks meals from loaded ingredients

technical_complexity.rationale: Home robot hardware that handles ingredient timing, food safety and cleaning is a hard consumer hardware problem for a two person team; first home tests are planned for November 2026.

defensibility.rationale: Posha already sells a similar product with funding; execution and price would decide.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy recorded; Posha raised a Series A in 2025.

market_need_then: Demand shown by Posha's sold-out first batch in 2025 and Mirabelle's own deposit preorders; no Mirabelle sales figures found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Dinner's ready; home as the most important place

branding.community_and_virality: Active on Instagram, TikTok, X and LinkedIn; no press on the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Warm human name and clear consumer voice, but no traction evidence yet; name is shared with other businesses.

outcome_analysis: Mirabelle is a Winter 2026 consumer hardware startup with preorders and first home tests planned for late 2026. There is no outcome yet; the main risks are hardware execution and an existing funded rival, Posha, while founders have shown consumer growth in a prior app.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125K seed with no investors and no date; the round rests on that single database. A cross-check search found no press or filing. A VCBacked page for a different Mirabelle ($1.1M, Bpifrance) was excluded as a different company.
